functional.statement: A household member can create, edit and delete items on the household's shared list
An item can be assigned to one member of the household
Completing an item records who completed it and when

nfr.statement: List reads are fast for a household
A member can never read another household's list
nfr.target: 0 cross-household reads in the authz test suite

telemetry.note: emit todo.item.completed with household and assignee

authz.note: every query is scoped by the household of the authenticated member

audit.note: membership changes are written to the audit sink

rollback.note: feature flag shared_lists plus image rollback

monitoring.note: 5xx rate and p95 latency alert to @platform

canary.note: 5% of households for 24 hours before full rollout

quota.reason: list sizes are bounded by household size; the gateway rate limit already applies

i18n.trigger: when the first non-English market is planned

multiTenancy.note: the household is the tenant; cross-household access is denied by default

capacitySlo.note: 99.9% monthly availability for list reads and writes

dr.note: managed PostgreSQL with point-in-time recovery, RPO 5 minutes
